name: Jiuquan SLC-43
manufacturer: China Aerospace Science and Technology Corp
best_known_for: China's crewed-spaceflight pad — every Shenzhou crew, every Tianzhou cargo run
credit: Long March 2F / Long March 7 pad at Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center. First flight Shenzhou 1 in November 1999; every subsequent Shenzhou crewed flight (1 through 19 as of 2025) lifted from Pad 91 of SLC-43, the dedicated crewed-pad pair. Tianzhou cargo missions to Tiangong (since 2017) fly Long March 7 from the same complex. Inland desert site, traditional inclinations only — Wenchang carries the equatorial / heavy-lift manifest. Coordinates from CNSA + public records.
